name: proto-blocks/oit-testimonial
title: OIT Single Testimonial
description: Centered testimonial card on a black section, framed by mirrored circuit decorations on both sides and capped with a red quote bubble.

source.label: Review Source
source.help: Manual uses the Quote/Attribution above. SmileBack pulls live reviews and rotates through them as a carousel.

maxReviews.label: Max SmileBack reviews
maxReviews.help: How many SmileBack reviews to include in the carousel (after filtering).

autoplaySeconds.label: Slide duration (seconds)
autoplaySeconds.help: How long each review shows before auto-advancing. Set to 0 to disable autoplay (arrows/dots only).

requireCompany.label: Only reviews with a company
requireCompany.help: Skip reviews that don't include a company name.

minLength.label: Minimum review length
minLength.help: Hide reviews shorter than this many characters (0 = no minimum).

showScore.label: Show CSAT score line
showScore.help: Shows the overall satisfaction score + review count above the card (SmileBack source only).

showCircuit.label: Show Circuit Decorations
showCircuit.help: Mirrored circuit patterns on the left and right of the section.
